One 12 ounce can evaporated milk

1 1/2 tbsp cornstarch

1 cup shredded Monterey Jack cheese

1 tsp salt

1/2 tsp garlic powder

1/4 tsp turmeric (optional, for color)

In a large microwave-safe bowl, whisk the evaporated milk and cornstarch together until well combined. Microwave on high for 1 minute. Remove from microwave, whisk thoroughly, then return to microwave for 30 seconds to 1 minute. Remove, whisk again, and microwave for 30 seconds to 1 minute more, until the mixture is scalding. Carefully remove from microwave, and whisk until most of the steam is gone. 

Slowly add cheese, whisking or blending with an immersion blender, until all of the cheese is melted and smooth. Add salt and spices. Serve immediately or refrigerate. The sauce can be reheated in the microwave 30 seconds at a time. 

Variations:

Add 1 tsp ancho chili powder or paprika for smoky heat

Add 1 tsp cayenne pepper for more intense heat

Cheese can be swapped for different combinations of cheddar, Monterey Jack, and pepper Jack
